limitations: Attribution labels describe observed field changes, not independently isolated causal experiments. Stable pathway keys: card identity, face, ability path, operation, branch. Duplicate bases use native-operation signatures and occurrence ordinals, never silent map overwrite. Changes to a duplicate variant signature can appear as removal+addition; inspect ambiguousPathwayBases.
No quality score: new/removed matches may be fixes or regressions. Different commanders/pools are explicitly flagged.
Coverage comparison needs --before-coverage and --after-coverage; discovery diff alone cannot reconstruct independent traversal.
